instrument: Ratepayer Protection Act, as passed by the U.S. House of Representatives
summary: H.R. 9340 passed the House 417-3 under suspension of the rules on Sept 16, 2026. It directs state regulators to consider standards so data centers of at least 100 MW at one site or campus pay the incremental cost of grid upgrades, with rates paid before construction. Senate companion S. 5028 (Sen. Husted); unanimous consent blocked Sept 17; a Senate test vote was signaled for the week of Sept 28.
notes: Senate action unknown. The vote margin is notable given the contested nature of the subject at state and local level.
confidence_note: Vote record read; bill text not read. 100 MW threshold and pre-construction payment reported (Deseret News, Benton).
